what_happened: Dispatch 4.md is headed phase=research and artifact output_dir=reports/, matching the general-research-agent contract, but its Description/GOAL/DELIVERABLE prose says 'Produce the implementation plan ... DELIVERABLE: An implementation plan.' Resolved by treating this as a research dispatch: wrote a research report (not a plan file) covering all 8 REQUIRED OUTCOMES in enough depth that a subsequent planning dispatch can produce the implementation plan directly from it, consistent with the Identity block (phase: research) and output_dir (reports/) which are the load-bearing, machine-checked fields.

Collision check for a new 'typescript' keyword_overrides entry: the web extension's manifest.json declares NO keyword_overrides block at all (confirmed by direct read), and none of the 6 other extensions in this repo that declare keyword_overrides (books, email, rust, cslib, typst, latex) contain any typescript/ts/tsx-adjacent keyword. The core weak-signal fallback table (task-type-detect.sh) also has no 'typescript' row -- web's own row is 'web,astro,tailwind,cloudflare'. A new typescript keyword_overrides entry is therefore collision-free against every currently-loaded and currently-defined manifest.

Re-deriving the research report's carried figures at plan-authoring time found five errors: (1) the file manifest omitted the skills/skill-typescript-{research,implementation}/SKILL.md pair that every language extension ships and declares in provides.skills; (2) provides.scripts was given as 'scripts/typescript-verify.sh' when the deploy copier takes a bare basename (verified against nix/manifest.json); (3) agent-system/extensions/README.md's Available Extensions table row was not mentioned at all, though lint-extension-readme-table.sh FAILs on a missing row; (4) typescript-web.md is 303 lines, not 304; (5) the report claimed lines 204-232 contain no Astro framing, but line 207 is 'import { z } from "astro/zod";'. All five are corrected in the plan.

Running suite_selection_select over representative paths from every phase's Files to modify list BEFORE writing any Tier Justification made each justification auditable rather than asserted, and surfaced that context/project/**/README.md maps to 16 real suites while agents/*.md, rules/*.md, contracts/*.md and scripts/*.sh map to __FULL_SWEEP__ -- so the sentinel is claimed only where the selector actually returns it. The outputs are recorded in a 'Verification-tier selector evidence' table in the plan.

Phase 1's Tier Justification named the gate subset verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 (doc-lint + task-reference lint) as the covering check. Running it after Phase 1 creates agent-system/extensions/typescript/context/project/typescript/** shows check-extension-docs.sh scans every subdirectory under agent-system/extensions/ unconditionally and FAILs with 'manifest.json missing' and 'README.md missing' for any new extension directory until manifest.json and README.md exist -- which Phase 5 (not Phase 1) creates. This is structural, not a defect in Phase 1's own content: the gate subset named for every Wave-1 phase (1-4) cannot genuinely pass until Phase 5 lands. Resolution: Phase 1 closes on its three content-level verification criteria (file existence, genericity grep zero-hits, no-duplicate-file assertion), with the doc-lint gate re-run and confirmed once Phase 5's manifest.json/README.md land (and again at Phase 6's full gate run).
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #620's declared file_scope.

Phase 5's full verify-deploy.sh gate run showed 4/44 checks failing on every attempt. Gate 20 (orchestrator context-budget overage, eager-load 70444B vs baseline 70400B, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md 25510B vs 25000B ceiling) is pre-existing: git log/git status confirm zero local diff on the flagged files, inherited from already-committed history (task 609 / prior task 274) unrelated to task 620's file_scope. Gate 10 (validate-state.sh --deep exceeded its 60s timeout) is a wall-clock ceiling mismatch, not a correctness defect: run standalone it genuinely passes (0 Failed) but takes 74.6s against specs/state.json's current size (157 active projects). Gate 8's run-all.sh batch showed a different flaky suite failing on different runs (test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh, then test-update-task-status.sh), each passing cleanly standalone (28/0 and 82/0 respectively) -- a parallel-execution contention artifact under --jobs auto, not a content regression. All three recorded as Reasoned Exclusions on Phase 5 with full evidence in the plan file.

Phase 5's gate run surfaced one genuine, task-620-caused regression: Phase 2's addition of typescript-implementation-agent.md to lint-agent-contracts.sh's OWNERSHIP_IN_SCOPE_RELATIVE_PATHS (Check G) was not mirrored into test-lint-agent-contracts-heartbeat.sh's own curated OWNERSHIP_PATHS fixture list, which is deliberately hand-maintained as a separate drift detector. This caused a new Check I FAIL (missing fixture file) in the full test suite. Fixed in Phase 5 by adding the entry to the test's OWNERSHIP_PATHS array and giving it the compliant (general-implementation-agent.md-style) fixture branch, since the real file genuinely invokes update-phase-status.sh. Re-ran the suite standalone after the fix: 6 passed, 0 failed.
